title: Integrability of a Gaussian noise pair product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ each belong to $L^2(\gamma_n)$, where $\gamma_n$ is the product standard Gaussian measure. If $X,Y$ are independent with law $\gamma_n$, then $(x,y)\mapsto f(x)g(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)$ is integrable with respect to $\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n$.
